name: @faqir-ui/core
description: Faqir UI runtime engine — the Alpine-style reactive core (faqir-core.js), minified CDN build, and prebuilt per-theme CSS bundles. Zero dependencies.
//exports: `.` resolves to dist/faqir-core.mjs — real ESM, `export default` plus one named export per engine member. It must NOT resolve to dist/faqir-core.js: that file is UMD, this package is `"type": "module"`, and under ESM the UMD wrapper takes its global branch and exports nothing, so the documented `import Faqir from "@faqir-ui/core"` failed with `SyntaxError: … does not provide an export named 'default'`. The UMD build is still shipped and is still what `<script src>`, unpkg and jsdelivr load; reach it explicitly at `@faqir-ui/core/faqir-core.js`.
//require: Deliberately absent. This package is ESM-only. The `require` condition used to point at the UMD file, which threw ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on Node 18 and 20 — most of the range `engines` promises — because `"type": "module"` classifies a `.js` file as ESM whatever its contents. Supporting `require` honestly would mean shipping a `.cjs` runtime AND a full-fidelity `.d.cts`, and a half-fidelity one recreates exactly the FalseCJS mismatch this shape was fixed to remove. On Node >=22.12 `require()` falls through to `default` and works; below that it fails with a message that names `import()`, which is the right answer.
